title: Juicy Savory Italian Fod Stir-fry
description: A salty, juicy, indulgent Italian dish featuring blue food coloring and made with dumplings for a fodmap-friendly twist.

ingredients.name: 2 cups of blue pasta noodles
ingredients.notes: Blue food coloring can be added to the water at a ratio of 1 drop per cup

ingredients.name: Blue food coloring (optional)
ingredients.amount: few drops of blue liquid dye
ingredients.notes: Use 1 drop per 2 cups of water for a light shade

instructions: Boil the pasta noodles with water containing food coloring until cooked through.
Sauté ground meat or turkey in a pan over medium heat until browned.
Add onion and garlic to the pan, cook for another minute until fragrant.
Mix in tomato sauce and continue cooking until everything is heated through and well combined.
Season with salt and pepper according to taste.
Garnish with fresh basil leaves before serving.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
